--[[
    ERASED DEX

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

local Theme = {
    Primary = Color3.fromHex("#ff0032"),
    Background = Color3.fromHex("#050505"),
    Surface = Color3.fromHex("#0f0f0f"),
    Card = Color3.fromHex("#141414"),
    Text = Color3.fromHex("#e5e2e1"),
    TextDim = Color3.fromHex("#888888"),
    Border = Color3.fromHex("#1a1a1a")
}

local State = {
    NormalFly = false,
    AnimFly = false,
    Speed = 16,
    NoClip = false,
    TouchFling = false,
    Attach = false,
    KillAura = false,
    TargetLock = false,
    AntiFling = false,
    Target = nil,
    FlyConn = nil,
    AnimFlyConn = nil,
    AttachConn = nil,
    NoClipConn = nil,
    KillAuraConn = nil,
    AntiFlingConn = nil
}

if game.CoreGui:FindFirstChild("ErasedDex") then
    game.CoreGui.ErasedDex:Destroy()
end

local Gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

-- Header

Header.Parent = Main

local HeaderFix = Instance.new("Frame")

HeaderFix.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -12)

HeaderFix.BorderSizePixel = 0

local Logo = Instance.new("TextLabel")

Logo.Text = "welcome to erased menu by imonstxrz"
Logo.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

Logo.Parent = Header

local Sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")

Sub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 32)
Sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Sub.Text = "ERASED DEX"
Sub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
Sub.TextSize = 20
Sub.TextColor3 = Theme.Primary
Sub.Parent = Header

local Close = Instance.new("TextButton")
Close.Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 26)
Close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 8)
Close.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Close.Text = "×"

Close.Parent = Header
Close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Gui:Destroy() end)

-- Content
local Content = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
Content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -115)
Content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 86)
Content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Content.BorderSizePixel = 0

Content.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Primary
Content.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 950)
Content.Parent = Main

local List = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
List.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)

-- Helpers
local function Section(text)
    local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    l.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
    l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    l.Text = text
    l.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    l.TextSize = 12
    l.TextColor3 = Theme.Primary
    l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    l.Parent = Content
end

local function Toggle(name, desc, callback)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Card
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = Content
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Theme.Border
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Parent = frame

    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 18)
    title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 7)
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Text = name
    title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    title.TextSize = 14
    title.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    title.Parent = frame

    local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 14)
    sub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 27)
    sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    sub.Text = desc
    sub.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    sub.TextSize = 11
    sub.TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim
    sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    sub.Parent = frame

    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 22)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -52, 0.5, -11)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
    btn.Text = ""
    btn.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -8)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120)
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.Parent = btn
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local on = false
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        on = not on
        if on then
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Primary
            knob.Position = UDim2.new(1, -19, 0.5, -8)
            knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
            stroke.Color = Theme.Primary
        else
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
            knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -8)
            knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120)
            stroke.Color = Theme.Border
        end
        callback(on)
    end)
end

local function Slider(name, min, max, default, callback)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Card
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = Content
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Theme.Border
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Parent = frame

    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0, 18)
    title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 6)
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Text = name
    title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    title.TextSize = 14
    title.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    title.Parent = frame

    local val = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    val.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 0, 18)
    val.Position = UDim2.new(0.72, 0, 0, 6)
    val.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    val.Text = tostring(default)
    val.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    val.TextSize = 13
    val.TextColor3 = Theme.Primary
    val.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    val.Parent = frame

    local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 5)
    bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 38)
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bar.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new((default-min)/(max-min), 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Primary
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = bar
    Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local dragging = false
    bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            local rel = math.clamp((i.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
            local v = math.floor(min + (max-min)*rel)
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
            val.Text = tostring(v)
            callback(v)
        end
    end)
end

local function Button(name, callback)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Card
    btn.Text = name
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.TextSize = 14
    btn.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
    btn.Parent = Content
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Theme.Border
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Parent = btn

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        stroke.Color = Theme.Primary
        btn.TextColor3 = Theme.Primary
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        stroke.Color = Theme.Border
        btn.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
    end)
end

-- Player List + Target
local PlayerListFrame = nil
local SelectedLabel = nil

local function SetTarget(plr)
    State.Target = plr
    if SelectedLabel then
        if plr then
            SelectedLabel.Text = "Selected: " .. plr.Name
            SelectedLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Primary
        else
            SelectedLabel.Text = "Selected: None"
            SelectedLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim
        end
    end
end

local function RefreshPlayerList()
    if not PlayerListFrame then return end
    for _, child in ipairs(PlayerListFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end
    end
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 28)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
            btn.Text = plr.Name
            btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
            btn.TextSize = 13
            btn.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
            btn.Parent = PlayerListFrame
            Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
            btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                SetTarget(plr)
            end)
        end
    end
end

-- ======================
-- BUILD UI
-- ======================

Section("MOVEMENT")

Toggle("Normal Fly", "Classic flight", function(on)
    State.NormalFly = on
    if State.AnimFly then return end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not root then return end
    if on then
        hum.PlatformStand = true
        local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bv.Name = "ED_Fly"
        bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
        bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        bv.Parent = root
        local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        bg.Name = "ED_Gyro"
        bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
        bg.P = 10000
        bg.Parent = root
        State.FlyConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not State.NormalFly then return end
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local dir = Vector3.zero
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += cam.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= cam.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= cam.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += cam.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end
            if dir.Magnitude > 0 then dir = dir.Unit * 50 end
            bv.Velocity = dir
            bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame
        end)
    else
        if State.FlyConn then State.FlyConn:Disconnect() State.FlyConn = nil end
        hum.PlatformStand = false
        if root:FindFirstChild("ED_Fly") then root.ED_Fly:Destroy() end
        if root:FindFirstChild("ED_Gyro") then root.ED_Gyro:Destroy() end
    end
end)

Toggle("Animated Fly", "Fly with cool animation", function(on)
    State.AnimFly = on
    if State.NormalFly then return end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not root then return end
    if on then
        hum.PlatformStand = true
        local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bv.Name = "ED_AnimFly"
        bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
        bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        bv.Parent = root
        local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        bg.Name = "ED_AnimGyro"
        bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
        bg.P = 3000
        bg.Parent = root
        local angle = 0
        State.AnimFlyConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            if not State.AnimFly then return end
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local dir = Vector3.zero
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += cam.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= cam.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= cam.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += cam.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end
            if dir.Magnitude > 0 then dir = dir.Unit * 55; angle = angle + dt * 8 else angle = angle + dt * 2 end
            bv.Velocity = dir
            bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.sin(angle)*15), 0, math.rad(math.cos(angle)*25))
        end)
    else
        if State.AnimFlyConn then State.AnimFlyConn:Disconnect() State.AnimFlyConn = nil end
        hum.PlatformStand = false
        if root:FindFirstChild("ED_AnimFly") then root.ED_AnimFly:Destroy() end
        if root:FindFirstChild("ED_AnimGyro") then root.ED_AnimGyro:Destroy() end
    end
end)

Slider("Speed", 16, 250, 16, function(v)
    State.Speed = v
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = v
    end
end)

Toggle("NoClip", "Walk through walls", function(on)
    State.NoClip = on
    if on then
        State.NoClipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if not State.NoClip then return end
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char then
                for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        if State.NoClipConn then State.NoClipConn:Disconnect() State.NoClipConn = nil end
    end
end)

-- Anti Fling
Toggle("Anti Fling", "Stops other players from flinging you", function(on)
    State.AntiFling = on
    if on then
        State.AntiFlingConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if not State.AntiFling then return end
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
                    for _, part in ipairs(plr.Character:GetChildren()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                            part.CanCollide = false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        if State.AntiFlingConn then
            State.AntiFlingConn:Disconnect()
            State.AntiFlingConn = nil
        end
        -- Restore collision
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
                for _, part in ipairs(plr.Character:GetChildren()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                        part.CanCollide = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

Section("PLAYER LIST")

SelectedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
SelectedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
SelectedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
SelectedLabel.Text = "Selected: None"
SelectedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
SelectedLabel.TextSize = 13
SelectedLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim
SelectedLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
SelectedLabel.Parent = Content

PlayerListFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
PlayerListFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 120)
PlayerListFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Card
PlayerListFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
PlayerListFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 3
PlayerListFrame.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Primary
PlayerListFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
PlayerListFrame.Parent = Content
Instance.new("UICorner", PlayerListFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
listLayout.Parent = PlayerListFrame
listLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()

local listPad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
listPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
listPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
listPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)

RefreshPlayerList()

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(0.3) RefreshPlayerList() end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.1)
    RefreshPlayerList()
    if State.Target and not State.Target.Parent then SetTarget(nil) end
end)

Button("Refresh Player List", function() RefreshPlayerList() end)

Section("ACTIONS")

Toggle("Target Lock", "Auto lock when you click near someone", function(on)
    State.TargetLock = on
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp or not State.TargetLock then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local ray = cam:ScreenPointToRay(Mouse.X, Mouse.Y)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

    local result = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 50, params)
    if result and result.Instance then
        local model = result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        if model then
            local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
            if plr and plr ~= LocalPlayer then
                SetTarget(plr)
                return
            end
        end
    end

    local closest, dist = nil, 12
    local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local other = plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local toOther = (other.Position - root.Position)
            local d = toOther.Magnitude
            if d < dist and toOther.Unit:Dot(look) > 0.4 then
                dist = d
                closest = plr
            end
        end
    end
    if closest then SetTarget(closest) end
end)

Toggle("Touch Fling", "Fling players on touch", function(on)
    State.TouchFling = on
    if not ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("juisdfj0i32i0eidsuf0iok") then
        local detection = Instance.new("Decal")
        detection.Name = "juisdfj0i32i0eidsuf0iok"
        detection.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
    end
    if on then
        task.spawn(function()
            local movel = 0.1
            while State.TouchFling do
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                local c = LocalPlayer.Character
                local hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp then
                    local vel = hrp.Velocity
                    hrp.Velocity = vel * 10000 + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)
                    RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                    hrp.Velocity = vel
                    RunService.Stepped:Wait()
                    hrp.Velocity = vel + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)
                    movel = -movel
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

Toggle("Attach", "Attach to selected player", function(on)
    State.Attach = on
    if on then
        if not State.Target then return end
        State.AttachConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not State.Attach or not State.Target or not State.Target.Character then return end
            local my = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local tr = State.Target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if my and tr then
                my.CFrame = tr.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 2.5)
            end
        end)
    else
        if State.AttachConn then State.AttachConn:Disconnect() State.AttachConn = nil end
    end
end)

Button("Teleport to Selected", function()
    if not State.Target or not State.Target.Character then return end
    local my = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local tr = State.Target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if my and tr then
        my.CFrame = tr.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
    end
end)

Toggle("Kill Aura", "Damage nearby players", function(on)
    State.KillAura = on
    if on then
        State.KillAuraConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not State.KillAura then return end
            local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not myRoot then return end
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
                    local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    local root = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if hum and root and hum.Health > 0 then
                        local dist = (myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                        if dist <= 15 then
                            pcall(function() hum:TakeDamage(10) end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        if State.KillAuraConn then State.KillAuraConn:Disconnect() State.KillAuraConn = nil end
    end
end)

local Footer = Instance.new("Frame")
Footer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
Footer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -28)
Footer.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Surface
Footer.BorderSizePixel = 0

local credit = Instance.new("TextLabel")
